context.title: San Francisco Public Bank Coalition: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition B (Establishing a Municipal Finance Corporation and a Public Bank)

positions.statement: San Francisco Public Bank Coalition signed the argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B and the rebuttal to the argument against San Francisco Proposition B and the paid argument in favor of San Francisco Proposition B in the San Francisco Voter Information Pamphlet.
